notes.title: Version 1.2
notes.notes:
It’s been 7 months since the last update. In  v1.1.7 a new FX system was introduced and caused the game to run slow on lower spec PCs.  Here in version 1.2 we have a major update to the game engine so the game will now run at the correct speed for everyone. If you have a high spec PC you probably won’t even notice any difference.

[b]BUGS FIXED[/b]
Frame skipping in some animations has now been fixed

[b]BEHIND THE SCENES[/b]
We’re almost ready to start adding new levels

notes.title: Version 1.1.7: Demo of new FX system
notes.notes:
So 1.14, 1.1.5, 1.1.6 never made it to public release and all their upgrades have been rolled into 1.1.7.

[b]New in this release[/b]

[b]LEVEL 1:[/b] Constant Fart Fog and the occasional Earthquake.

[b]LEVEL 2:[/b] Play level 2 as if you are watching it on a 1980's TV

[b]LEVEL 3:[/b] Everything white (Lights, gas jets etc.) now glows!

[b]LEVEL 4:[/b] 90's PC pixelated graphics and infrared

[b]LEVEL 5:[/b] Now a dimly lit room. You only see what the torch (Flashlight) illuminates


[b]Know issues[/b]

Animations of Mutant Poops are skipping frames so their walking is glitching.
Oxygen Tanks on level 4 don’t always appear when they should (even though Mission Control says they are there).
Game Over cut scene sometimes play at the end of successful level completion or when turning very late.

notes.title: 1.1.3 Demo of New Features
notes.notes:
[b]1.1.3[/b]

Only the second update this year as I have been soooooo busy but we are nearly there! It’s 99% of where I want to be for the full release.

All the main features now work (some are a little buggy) and have now been added to the first 4 demo levels as follows:

[b]LEVEL 1: Map and Speedboost[/b]

Speedboost was in the previous release. It now works a little better and you now get multiple chances to use it. The maps have always been in the game but have been hidden from public view.

[b]LEVEL 2: Third person, Fluid View and Dripping Diarrhoea[/b]

We get to see Don in all his glory for the first time. He crouches down to squish the poops. Since adding the shifting camera perspex in version 1.1, every level had it. Now it can just be in some of them

Newly added to version 1.1.3, here we see the dripping diarrhoea for the first time. The death sequence needs work but you get the idea.

[b]LEVEL 3: Roller Shutters & Fart Jets:[/b]

Another new feature is the roller shutters. This is a basic implementation and you can still turn as if they are not there. The mutant poops can open them. In future updates you will need to press a button before turning

Don’t touch the burning fart gas, you’ll die.

[b]LEVEL 4: Dripping Diarrhoea, Map & Third Person[/b]

All as described above.

notes.title: Version 1.1.2
notes.notes:
[b]New in this version (1.1.2)[/b]

My first update in over 6 months as I've been so busy with other projects.

Back in February [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/marekdd]DDtective[/url] sent me a crash report but I couldn't recreate it, then...... about a month ago I found the problem on level 4, which is the only level in the Early Access version that has mutant poops jumping out of the walls. They used to work fine before version 1.1 but the new motion added in 1.1 completely broke the system so I have spent the last month fixing it. This is the only change in this version. I hope to have more time to work on the game over the next few months.

If you have anything you would like to see, please get in touch.

notes.title: The update that's NOT an update!
notes.notes:
New in this version (1.0.215)


ABSOLUTELY NOTHING!!!!!!

As I was about to release [b]Don Flatus: Poop Hunter[/b] back in November 2020, the programming language used to make the game had a massive update. It caused all sorts of glitches, crashes and problems so I have been using an outdated version of the language since the games release.....

Until now!

All the issues caused by the language update have been dealt with (I hope!). So this version should be [i]exactly[/i] the same as 1.0.214 (still hoping!)

If you are seeing anything that is different or are getting any bugs, please get in touch

Thanks for your time,
Scott A. Cooke
Creator of Don Flatus: Poop Hunter

notes.title: Continued Animation Update
notes.notes:
New in this version (1.0.214)


SKELETAL ANIMATIONS

1) In the last update I announced the start of converting bitmap animations into skeletal animations. In this update I have continued converting more of the animations. You probably won't even notice the change but this work is freeing up processing power for a BIG change that I'm working on!

BEHIND THE SCENES

2) I have continued work on the game engine. As a player, you won't really see anything (YET!). The work that has been done will enable [i]big[/i] changes and advancements for future updates.

If you have anything you would like to see, please get in touch.

notes.title: Bug Fix & Start of New Animation Type
notes.notes:
New in this version (1.0.213)


SKELETAL ANIMATIONS

1) I have started converting bitmap animations into skeletal animations. Only the running poop has been done in this update, the rest will be done in future update. This should free up a lot of processing power for other new features that are planned.

BUGS FIXED

2) Stylex reported that a complete crash of the game happened when he got 3 crystals in a level. This has now been fixed.

BEHIND THE SCENES

3) I have done a lot of work on the game engine. As a player, you won't really see anything (YET!). The work that has been done will enable big changes and advancements for future updates.

If you have anything you would like to see, please get in touch.

notes.title: New SpeedRunner Feature, Achievements & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[b]New in this version (1.0.212)[/b]

[b]NEW SPEED RUNNER FEATURE[/b]
1) This is a working demo (currently only in level 1). When you first turn down a different corridor to the mutant poop (in level 1), SpeedRunner icons will appear. Collect one to speed up, keep collecting them to continue in high speed mode. Once you return to normal speed the feature will end.
2) Speed Run for 15 seconds or more to unlock the SpeedRunner achievement.

[b]NEW ACHIEVEMENTS[/b]
As well as the SpeedRunner achievement stated above, the following have been added:
3) Score 100,000 points or more in a level to unlock the 100k achievement.
4) Score 250,000 points or more in a level to unlock the 250k achievement.
5) Score 500,000 points or more in a level to unlock the 500k achievement.

[b]BUGS FIXED[/b]
6) Sometimes, after turning down a different corridor to the mutant poop, it would take an age to find it again.
7) If a crystal was on screen as the level was completed it would move in the background while the end of level stats were on screen.
8) Poops would sometimes continue past the last turn and walk through the “Attacking Poop” at the end of the corridor.

[b]EXTRA CRYSTALS[/b]
9) Up to 3 crystal can now be collected on each level.

If you have anything you would like to see, please get in touch.

notes.title: New File System & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[b]New in this version (1.0.211)[/b]

[b]NEW FILE SYSTEM[/b]
1) Multiple users can now be on one PC/Mac and the game will track each users progress
2) Fixed bug that displayed empty tables for levels not yet completed by the user
3) Fixed bug that sometimes uploaded scores to wrong levels

[b]OFFLINE DATA HANDLING[/b]
4) After completing a level, the game will now progress to the next level (as it always has when online)

[b]ACHIEVEMENTS[/b]
5) Removed the two impossible achievements (collecting 100 GlutBugs and collecting 200 GlutBugs)
New achievements will be coming in the next update

[b]GLUTBUG “HIT BOX"[/b]
6) There has been timing issues since adding active poop squishing in 1.0.209. Some users felt they were squishing the GlutBugs but it wasn’t registering.
This has now been rectified by allowing the GlutBugs to completely drift of the bottom of the screen and not having them suddenly disappear

[b]OTHER BUGS[/b]
6) Fixed score counter at end of corridor. It had been stopping just before the last turn
7) The helper text that is displayed in level1 would sometimes flash up for 1 frame in other levels. Not any more!

[b]Forthcoming Features for 2021 [/b]
Yes I know I said these would be in this update but I felt that all the above issues should be sorted before adding new content.
a) Doors will be locked and will need to be unlocked with a control panel. 
b) New content will be added to corridors that don't have the mutant poop. Currenlty nothing much happens in them.

If you have anything you would like to see, please get in touch.

notes.title: New Focus on Leaderboards
notes.notes:
New in this version (1.0.210)

[b]LEADERBOARDS[/b]
1) Leaderboards for world best scores and fastest time are now shown when you complete each level. Previously this feature was only avaialble by clicking the '123' box in the top left corner of each 'Level Select' button.

2) Leaderboards now show your best score and time, and the 20 players around you. Previously only the top 10 players were shown, if you weren't in the top 10, you did not see your scores and times.

[b]MISSION CONTROL[/b]
3) Mission control now recalculates routes alot quicker after you make a 'wrong' turn, makes less mistakes and no longer gets completely 'lost' (I hope!)

4) Mission control now also gives dirctions for oxygen tanks

5) Levels now have more than one crystal

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
6) In the last version (1.0.209) the page that showed the game controls was displaying at the wrong scale so wasn't entirely visable

7) Mutant poops no longer walk through walls

8) Mutant poops no longer peep in the middle of walls

9) Fixed bug where sometimes game doesn’t end when Mutant poop finishes dropping GlutBugs

10) Fixed missing wall graphics that mysteriously disappeared in the last version

[b]Forthcoming Features for 2021[/b]
Doors will be locked and will need to be unlocked with a control panel. This is almost ready and I hoped to get it done for this update but a lot of the issues above needed to be sorted before it could be done.

New content will be added to corridors that don't have the mutant poop. Currenlty nothing much happens in them.

If you have anything you would like to see, please get in touch.

notes.title: Bounce & Beep
notes.notes:
Reviewers have said that there needs to be more gameplay. I have taken this on board and plan to add new features in early 2021.

1) In previous versions, you just had to move your hand and wait for the GlutBug to reach you. Now you need to actively squish the GlutBugs. Mouse: left button or Steam GamePad: Right trigger.

2) I have seen player videos where people are hammering away on their controller thinking the controls don't work. Trying to turn down corridors too early now gives an audio buzz and controls will not activate unless you turn at the right time. An audio beep will sound when you have successfully turned. If you've ever played 80s arcade classics, Dragon's Lair and Space Ace, you will get this!
[i](This may be a temporary feature as the forthcoming "locked doors" (see below) may require this to be removed)[/i]

3) GlutGugs now bounce. This is a part of a future update.

4) There's a lot of backend alterations, optimization and adjustments to prepare for the new content in early 2021.

5) Graphics are now sharper on screens that are not 16:9 (eg. Macbooks)

[b]Forthcoming Features for 2021[/b]

Doors will be locked and will need to be unlocked with a control panel.
Mission control will give directions to oxygen tanks
Multiple crystals will need to be found to complete a puzzle at the end of the level

If you have anything you would like to see, please get in touch.

notes.notes:

1) Unlocked levels sometimes relock - FIXED
2) PlugBugs go off screen (Most noticable in level 5) - FIXED
